name: The Peninsula Paris
positioning: Peninsula's first European hotel, in a 1908 building that was long the Hotel Majestic, on Avenue Kléber steps from the Arc de Triomphe, with a two-Michelin-star aviation-themed rooftop restaurant
best_for: Travelers who want a Paris base steps from the Arc de Triomphe
Food lovers interested in a two-Michelin-star rooftop restaurant and Cantonese dining
Guests who value art and history in the public spaces

facts.text: The hotel is at 19 Avenue Kléber in Paris.
The hotel is steps away from the Arc de Triomphe.
More than 80 works of art, curated by Hong Kong-based Sabrina Fung Fine Arts, are displayed throughout the hotel.
Rooms pair Haussmannian character with sitting areas and walk-in dressing rooms.
L'Oiseau Blanc is led by Chef David Bizet.
LiLi, the Cantonese restaurant, hosts live traditional Chinese music Thursday through Saturday.
The Peninsula Spa blends French beauty with Asian treatment traditions.
Two fitness rooms were fully renovated in March 2025 with Technogym equipment.
The Saturday morning yoga class is complimentary for hotel guests with advance booking through the Spa.
The hotel's car fleet includes customised Peninsula Edition MINI Cooper S Clubmans and BMW 7 Series.

highlights.text: The rooftop restaurant L'Oiseau Blanc has held two Michelin stars since 2021, renewed in 2026.
L'Oiseau Blanc is aviation-themed, honouring Charles Nungesser and François Coli, who attempted to cross the Atlantic in 1927 from Le Bourget.
A four-year restoration turned the building into the Peninsula brand's first European hotel in 2014.
The Rooftop Eiffel Suite has a private rooftop garden with Eiffel Tower views.
Bar Kléber's oak paneling and gilded moldings recall the building's earlier life as the Majestic.

considerations.text: Children must be accompanied by a parent or guardian when using the pool.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's ultra-luxury positioning.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is in a busy tourist area.
